headline: Quiet day: Memphis rejects a data center pause but tightens rules
body: A quiet day. Memphis City Council split 6-6 on a 12-month data center moratorium, so it failed, but passed strict siting and water rules (Tech Backlash +0.02). Envision commissioned a gigawatt-scale AI campus in Ulanqab, China (Capability Velocity +0.05). Scores barely moved. Contained stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance edged up to -9.18.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Conquerors -0.09, from fading earlier news (-0.12), partly offset by the Ulanqab campus (+0.03); Descendants -0.08, from fading earlier news (-0.11), partly offset by the Ulanqab campus (+0.03).
